title: Briefing for 2026-10-27
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-27: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey. UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations. Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes. India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit. U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. Dividend stocks are having an excellent October as tech sector struggles.
global: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback. Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement. Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing. Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile. Healey pledges cheaper marmalade and gherkins in pre-Budget package of 'everyday fixes'. Bolsonaro’s party accepts Brazil election after Trump calls vote ‘rigged’.
philippines: Rappler Recap: What are Zalameda, Dimaampao, and Marquez’s plans as chief justice bets?. After 14 years, P1.49-billion Ifugao irrigation project finally opens. Lessons for the Philippines: AI content surge bypassed Brazil’s election rules — report. Thermal Blueprint: USER INTERFACE 2026 Resurfaces with Technology-Driven Climate Innovation.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
